content.title: Recommendations for the treatment of diabetes in heart failure

recommendations.text: SGLT2 inhibitors (canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, ertugliflozin, sotagliflozin) are recommended in patients with T2DM at risk of CV events to reduce hospitalizations for HF, major CV events, end-stage renal dysfunction, and CV death.
SGLT2 inhibitors (dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, and sotagliflozin) are recommended in patients with T2DM and HFrEF to reduce hospitalizations for HF and CV death.

abbreviations.HFrEF: heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

content.section_13.2_Thyroid_disorders: Assessment of thyroid function is recommended in all patients with HF because both hypo- and hyperthyroidism may cause or precipitate HF. Subclinical hypothyroidism and isolated low triiodothyronine levels were associated with poorer outcomes in observational studies in patients with HF.

genes.context: SGLT2 inhibitors are recommended for patients with T2DM at risk of cardiovascular events and for patients with T2DM and HFrEF to reduce HF hospitalizations and CV death; SGLT2 is expanded in the abbreviations as sodium-glucose co-transporter 2.
